attributes.series: KWEF African Languages Monographs, volume 8, published by Rüdiger Köppe Verlag.
attributes.size: 825 pages, with 109 colour photos, a map, tables and a grammar sketch.
attributes.status: Out of print at the distributor's page.
attributes.licence: Copyrighted. Ask the publisher or the compilers for permission before building an open lexicon from it.
attributes.value: The largest structured source of Lamnso' vocabulary I found, and its compilers describe it as a first attempt at a significant corpus of Lamnso' vocabulary with grammatical, semantic and usage information.

source.citation: Wycliffe Canada story on the Lamnso Bible, the Bible.com audio page for the Lamnso' New Testament, and a University of Edinburgh thesis on Bible use in Nso churches. Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

attributes.translator: Cameroon Association for Bible Translation and Literacy (CABTAL), with Wycliffe involvement.
attributes.history: Translation began in 1971. The New Testament was in use for more than 20 years before 2005. The complete Bible was dedicated in November 2016, together with a Lamnso' dictionary.
attributes.new_testament_2014: A 2014 edition of the New Testament is published, with an audio version on the Bible.com app (copyright CABTAL, 2014).
attributes.licence: Copyrighted by CABTAL. Ask CABTAL for permission before any reuse.
attributes.value: Probably the largest body of written Lamnso' text, and one that can be aligned verse by verse with English for translation research, if permission is given.

source.citation: Global Recordings Network, Lamnso' language page and program pages. Compiled for this collection and not yet reviewed by a second person.

attributes.contents: Bible lessons in 40 sections, the Jesus Story audio drama (1 hour 26 minutes), and song compilations including Songs 4 by the Kikaykela'ki Choir (42 minutes).
attributes.also_available: The Jesus Film in Lamnso' from the Jesus Film Project, and the 2014 New Testament audio from Faith Comes By Hearing.
attributes.licence: GRN says recordings may be freely copied for personal or local ministry use if they are not modified, not sold and not bundled with products that are sold. Other uses need permission from GRN.
attributes.value: Hours of spoken and sung Lamnso', but religious content only and not licensed for open datasets or model training.

attributes.value: An ethnographic study from 2002 to 2003 of how Catholic, Presbyterian, Baptist and Church of Christ congregations in one Nso' village use Lamnso', English and Pidgin Bibles. It describes how Lamnso' is used in daily life.
attributes.access: The full PDF (about 42 MB) is listed on the Edinburgh Research Archive.
